risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified and explains revenue declines, lower bookings, reduced backlog, market weakness, customer concentration, and continuing segment losses. Risk tone is moderately negative because recovery depends on customer adoption and completion of a voltage-standard transition, while litigation costs and defense-market weakness remain uncertain. Some forward-looking language and truncated accounting discussion limit full assessment of downside exposure.
